_description: Starter pack for EVPN MAC mobility tests (SW-204115 family). Covers AC<->AC moves, MAC suppression, freeze/restore-cycles, and local-loop-prevention behaviors.

show_commands.purpose: Verify MAC source after each move (AC1, AC2, suppressed).
Drill into one MAC's full state (move count, freeze, source).

Per-MAC suppression/move table (cycles + remaining suppress time). REPLACES the incorrect 'show evpn instance <name> mac-suppression' from earlier docs -- live-validated REJECTED on dev_v26_2 build 8fd38d35a10a 2026-04-30.

show_commands.command: show evpn instance <name> loop-prevention mac-table local
show_commands.purpose: Local-only view of MAC suppression/move table.

show_commands.command: show config network-services evpn instance <name> mac-handling

syntax_traps: WRONG: 'clear evpn mac-suppression instance X' -- the order is INVERTED
WRONG: 'show evpn mac-table instance X detail' -- 'detail' must come BEFORE 'instance'
RIGHT: 'show evpn mac-table detail instance X' OR 'show evpn detail instance X'
LLP uses 'restore-timer' (no mac- prefix) at the local-loop-prevention level; outer loop-prevention level uses 'mac-restore-timer'.

WRONG: 'show evpn instance X mac-suppression' / 'mac-history' / 'restore-cycles' -- these are CLEAR-side verbs only. Live-validated rejected on PE-4 dev_v26_2 build 8fd38d35a10a 2026-04-30. Use 'show evpn instance X loop-prevention {interface|local|mac-table|mac-ip-table}' instead.

WRONG: 'show evpn local-loop-prevention' -- not a valid show keyword. Use 'show evpn instance X loop-prevention local' (local-loop-prevention only exists in CONFIG mode under mac-handling > loop-prevention).
_see_also: evpn-loop-prevention.json -- canonical, fully validated loop-prevention syntax pack from 2026-04-30 PE-4 discovery.
